title: चतुश्चत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Dhritarashtra asks about the discipline of the Brahman-student, and Sanatsujata describes its four quarters: devotion to the teacher, effort, time and the company of fellow students. Through this life of discipline, he says, one attains the great, imperishable glory.
summary.kn: ಬ್ರಹ್ಮಚರ್ಯದ ಶಿಸ್ತಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರನು ಕೇಳಿದಾಗ, ಗುರುಭಕ್ತಿ, ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ, ಕಾಲ, ಸಹಪಾಠಿಗಳ ಸಂಗ ಎಂಬ ಅದರ ನಾಲ್ಕು ಪಾದಗಳನ್ನು ಸನತ್ಸುಜಾತರು ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಈ ಶಿಸ್ತಿನ ಜೀವನದಿಂದ ಮಹಾ ಅವಿನಾಶಿ ಕೀರ್ತಿ ದೊರೆಯುವುದು ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: धृतराष्ट्र ब्रह्मचारी के अनुशासन के बारे में पूछते हैं, और सनत्सुजात उसके चार पाद बताते हैं: गुरुभक्ति, प्रयत्न, काल और सहपाठियों का संग। वे कहते हैं कि इस अनुशासित जीवन से महान, अविनाशी यश प्राप्त होता है।
summary.te: బ్రహ్మచర్య క్రమశిక్షణ గురించి ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు అడగగా, గురుభక్తి, ప్రయత్నం, కాలం, సహపాఠుల సాంగత్యం అనే దాని నాలుగు పాదాలను సనత్సుజాతుడు వర్ణిస్తాడు. ఈ క్రమశిక్షణ జీవితంతో మహత్తరమైన, అవినాశి కీర్తి లభిస్తుందని అంటాడు.
summary.ta: ப்ரஹ்மசாரியின் ஒழுக்கம் பற்றி த்ருதராஷ்டிரன் கேட்க, குரு பக்தி, முயற்சி, காலம், உடன் பயில்வோரின் கூட்டு என்ற அதன் நான்கு பகுதிகளை ஸனத்ஸுஜாதர் விவரிக்கிறார். இந்த ஒழுக்க வாழ்வால் பெரும், அழியாப் புகழ் கிட்டும் என்கிறார்.
summary.ml: ബ്രഹ്മചാരിയുടെ വ്രതത്തെക്കുറിച്ച് ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ ചോദിക്കുന്നു; അതിന്റെ നാലു ഭാഗങ്ങളായ ഗുരുഭക്തി, പ്രയത്നം, കാലം, സഹപാഠികളുടെ കൂട്ട് എന്നിവ സനത്സുജാതൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു. വ്രതജീവിതത്തിലൂടെ മഹത്തും നശിക്കാത്തതുമായ കീർത്തി നേടാമെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 5.44; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Jan 23 2024

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
सनत्सुजात यदिमां परार्थां
ब्राह्मीं वाचं प्रवदसि विश्वरूपाम् ।
परां हि कामेषु सुदुर्लभां कथां
तद्ब्रूहि मे वाक्यमेतत्कुमार ॥

meaning.en: Sanatsujata, this speech of Brahman that you declare, with its meaning for the highest, of every form, and the supreme account so hard to find among desires: speak it to me, young sage.

verses.text: सनत्सुजात उवाच

meaning.en: Sanatsujata said:

verses.text:
नैतद्ब्रह्म त्वरमाणेन लभ्यं
यन्मां पृच्छस्यभिहृष्यस्यतीव ।
अव्यक्तविद्यामभिधास्ये पुराणीं
बुद्ध्या च तेषां ब्रह्मचर्येण सिद्धाम् ॥

meaning.en: This Brahman is not gained by one in a hurry, as you ask me, greatly excited. I will explain the ancient, unmanifest knowledge, perfected by understanding and celibacy.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
अव्यक्तविद्यामिति यत्सनातनीं
ब्रवीषि त्वं ब्रह्मचर्येण सिद्धाम् ।
अनारभ्या वसतीहार्य काले
कथं ब्राह्मण्यममृतत्वं लभेत ॥

meaning.en: The eternal unmanifest knowledge you speak of, perfected by celibacy: how, living here in time without undertaking it, noble one, can one gain brahmanhood and immortality?

verses.text: सनत्सुजात उवाच

meaning.en: Sanatsujata said:

verses.text:
येऽस्मिँल्लोके विजयन्तीह कामा-
न्ब्राह्मीं स्थितिमनुतितिक्षमाणाः ।
त आत्मानं निर्हरन्तीह देहा-
न्मुञ्जादिषीकामिव सत्त्वसंस्थाः ॥

meaning.en: Those who here conquer desires, patiently enduring the state of Brahman, draw out the self from the body, like a reed from its sheath, standing in goodness.

verses.text:
शरीरमेतौ कुरुतः पिता माता च भारत ।
आचार्यशास्ता या जातिः सा सत्या साजरामरा ॥

meaning.en: Father and mother make the body, Bharata; but the birth given by the teacher, that is true, ageless and deathless.

verses.text:
आचार्ययोनिमिह ये प्रविश्य
भूत्वा गर्भं ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति ।
इहैव ते शास्त्रकारा भवन्ति
प्रहाय देहं परमं यान्ति योगम् ॥

meaning.en: Those who enter the teacher's womb here and become embryos, practicing celibacy, become authors of the scriptures even here, and leaving the body go to supreme union.

verses.text:
य आवृणोत्यवितथेन कर्णा-
वृतं कुर्वन्नमृतं संप्रयच्छन् ।
तं मन्येत पितरं मातरं च
तस्मै न द्रुह्येत्कृतमस्य जानन् ॥

meaning.en: He who covers his ears with truth, making them covered and giving immortality, one should regard him as father and mother, and not harm him, knowing what he has done.

verses.text:
गुरुं शिष्यो नित्यमभिमन्यमानः
स्वाध्यायमिच्छेच्छुचिरप्रमत्तः ।
मानं न कुर्यान्न दधीत रोष-
मेष प्रथमो ब्रह्मचर्यस्य पादः ॥

meaning.en: The pupil, always regarding the teacher with respect, pure and careful, should seek study; he should not be proud or hold anger. This is the first quarter of celibacy.

verses.text:
आचार्यस्य प्रियं कुर्यात्प्राणैरपि धनैरपि ।
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा द्वितीयः पाद उच्यते ॥

meaning.en: He should do what pleases the teacher with life and wealth, in deed, mind and speech; this is called the second quarter.

verses.text:
समा गुरौ यथा वृत्तिर्गुरुपत्न्यां तथा भवेत् ।
यथोक्तकारी प्रियकृत्तृतीयः पाद उच्यते ॥

meaning.en: As he behaves toward the teacher, so should he toward the teacher's wife; doing as told and pleasing: this is called the third quarter.

verses.text:
नाचार्यायेहोपकृत्वा प्रवादं
प्राज्ञः कुर्वीत नैतदहं करोमि ।
इतीव मन्येत न भाषयेत
स वै चतुर्थो ब्रह्मचर्यस्य पादः ॥

meaning.en: The wise one should not blame the teacher, having been helped by him, nor say, "I do not do this"; he should think so and not say it. This is the fourth quarter of celibacy.

verses.text:
एवं वसन्तं यदुपप्लवेद्धन-
माचार्याय तदनुप्रयच्छेत् ।
सतां वृत्तिं बहुगुणामेवमेति
गुरोः पुत्रे भवति च वृत्तिरेषा ॥

meaning.en: If wealth comes to him as he lives so, he should give it to the teacher; thus he attains the many-virtued conduct of the good, and this conduct passes to the teacher's son.

verses.text:
एवं वसन्सर्वतो वर्धतीह
बहून्पुत्राँल्लभते च प्रतिष्ठाम् ।
वर्षन्ति चास्मै प्रदिशो दिशश्च
वसन्त्यस्मिन्ब्रह्मचर्ये जनाश्च ॥

meaning.en: Living so he grows in every way here, gets many sons and an established position; the quarters and directions rain upon him, and people dwell in this celibacy.

verses.text:
एतेन ब्रह्मचर्येण देवा देवत्वमाप्नुवन् ।
ऋषयश्च महाभागा ब्रह्मलोकं मनीषिणः ॥

meaning.en: By this celibacy the gods attained godhood, and the great-souled wise seers attained the world of Brahman.

verses.text:
गन्धर्वाणामनेनैव रूपमप्सरसामभूत् ।
एतेन ब्रह्मचर्येण सूर्यो अह्नाय जायते ॥

meaning.en: By this the Gandharvas and Apsarases gained their beauty; by this celibacy the sun rises to bring the day.

verses.text:
य आशयेत्पाटयेच्चापि राज-
न्सर्वं शरीरं तपसा तप्यमानः ।
एतेनासौ बाल्यमत्येति विद्वा-
न्मृत्युं तथा रोधयत्यन्तकाले ॥

meaning.en: He who, king, wishes to dry up and tear apart his whole body, tormented by austerity, with this the knower passes beyond childhood and stops death at the end.

verses.text:
अन्तवन्तः क्षत्रिय ते जयन्ति
लोकाञ्जनाः कर्मणा निर्मितेन ।
ब्रह्मैव विद्वांस्तेन अभ्येति सर्वं
नान्यः पन्था अयनाय विद्यते ॥

meaning.en: Those with an end, kshatriya, win worlds by their made deeds; but the knower reaches everything by Brahman alone; there is no other path for going.

verses.text: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच

meaning.en: Dhritarashtra said:

verses.text:
आभाति शुक्लमिव लोहितमिव
अथो कृष्णमथाञ्जनं काद्रवं वा ।
तद्ब्राह्मणः पश्यति योऽत्र विद्वा-
न्कथंरूपं तदमृतमक्षरं पदम् ॥

meaning.en: It appears white, or red, or black, or dark, or tawny. The brahmin who knows here sees it; what is the form of that deathless, imperishable state?

verses.text: सनत्सुजात उवाच

meaning.en: Sanatsujata said:

verses.text:
नाभाति शुक्लमिव लोहितमिव
अथो कृष्णमायसमर्कवर्णम् ।
न पृथिव्यां तिष्ठति नान्तरिक्षे
नैतत्समुद्रे सलिलं बिभर्ति ॥

meaning.en: It does not appear white or red, nor black, nor iron-colored, nor sun-colored. It does not stand on earth or in the sky; the sea does not hold it as water.

verses.text:
न तारकासु न च विद्युदाश्रितं
न चाभ्रेषु दृश्यते रूपमस्य ।
न चापि वायौ न च देवतासु
न तच्चन्द्रे दृश्यते नोत सूर्ये ॥

meaning.en: It is not in the stars, it does not rest on lightning, and its form is not seen in clouds. Not in the wind or among the gods, not seen in the moon or in the sun.

verses.text:
नैवर्क्षु तन्न यजुःषु नाप्यथर्वसु
न चैव दृश्यत्यमलेषु सामसु ।
रथंतरे बार्हते चापि राज-
न्महाव्रते नैव दृश्येद्ध्रुवं तत् ॥

meaning.en: It is not in the Rik verses, nor the Yajus, nor the Atharva, nor seen in the pure Samans; not in the Rathantara or Brihat, or the Mahavrata, king; that firm one is not seen.

verses.text:
अपारणीयं तमसः परस्ता-
त्तदन्तकोऽप्येति विनाशकाले ।
अणीयरूपं क्षुरधारया त-
न्महच्च रूपं त्वपि पर्वतेभ्यः ॥

meaning.en: It is unfathomable, beyond the darkness; even the Ender goes to it at the time of destruction. Its form is subtler than a razor's edge, and yet greater than the mountains.

verses.text:
सा प्रतिष्ठा तदमृतं लोकास्तद्ब्रह्म तद्यशः ।
भूतानि जज्ञिरे तस्मात्प्रलयं यान्ति तत्र च ॥

meaning.en: That is the foundation, that the immortal, that the worlds, that Brahman, that glory. From it beings were born, and into it they go at dissolution.

verses.text:
अनामयं तन्महदुद्यतं यशो
वाचो विकारान्कवयो वदन्ति ।
तस्मिञ्जगत्सर्वमिदं प्रतिष्ठितं
ये तद्विदुरमृतास्ते भवन्ति ॥

meaning.en: That is sound, great, uplifted glory; the wise speak of modifications of speech. In it this whole world is established; those who know it become immortal.
